title: SUOMEN METSÄKESKUS TIETOPYYNTÖ – PUUSTOTULKINTA
description: TIETOPYYNNÖN TARKOITUS Suomen metsäkeskus (jäljempänä Hankintayksikkö) on kilpailuttamassa 2025 kaukokartoitusperusteisen metsien inventoinnin puustotulkintaa ja koealamittauksia. Tarjoukset tullaan pyytämään inventointialueittain, joita on näillä näkymin 20 kappaletta (tarjouspyynnön osa-alueet) ja tarjoaja voi jättää tarjouksen yhdestä tai useammasta osa-alueesta. Toimittaja valitaan osa-alueittain. Kaukokartoitusperusteinen metsien inventoinnin puustotulkinta ja koealamittaukset ovat Hankintayksikön lakisääteinen tehtävä ja tulosten oikeellisuus on kriittistä lakisääteisen tehtävän täyttämiseksi. Hankinnan kohteena oleva palvelu edellyttää toimittajalta osaamista, jota on mahdollista saavuttaa vain kokemuksen kautta. Tästä syystä hankinnassa on perinteisesti asetettu toimittajille referenssivaatimuksia, joilla toimittaja osoittaa kyvykkyytensä suoriutua hankinnan kohteena olevista palveluista. Hankintayksikkö on päättänyt mahdollistaa kilpailuun osallistumisen puustotulkinnan osalta enintään kahteen osa-alueeseen myös sellaisille toimittajille, joilla ei ole aiempia referenssejä. Osallistuminen edellyttää tällöin jäljempänä kuvatun näyttötyön tekemistä siten, että näyttötyö on hyväksyttävästi suoritettu ennen kun toimittaja jättää tarjouksen tulevassa tarjouskilpailussa. Rajaus kahteen osa-alueeseen johtuu siitä, että jos toimittaja epäonnistuu tehtävässä, Hankintayksikkö todennäköisesti saa ajoissa hankittua korvaavan palvelun puustotulkintaan kahdella osa-alueella. Tällä tietopyynnöllä Hankintayksikkö tiedottaa tulevasta tarjouskilpailusta ja siitä, millä edellytyksillä toimittaja, jolla ei ole vaadittuja referenssejä, voi päästä kilpailuun mukaan. HANKINNAN KOHDET Suomen metsäkeskus tulee kilpailuttamaan kaukokartoitusperusteisen metsien inventoinnin puustotulkinnan ja koealamittaukset. Tarjoukset tullaan pyytämään inventointialueittain, joita on alustavasti 20 kappaletta (tarjouspyynnön osa-alueet) ja tarjoaja voi jättää tarjouksen yhdestä tai useammasta osa-alueesta. Toimittaja valitaan osa-alueittain. Kaukokartoitusperusteinen metsien puustotulkinta toteutetaan 20 inventointialueella mannersuomessa. Tuleva hankinta sisältää puustotulkinnat kaikilla alueilla ja koealamittaukset kymmenellä (10) alueella. Yhden inventointialueen bruttopinta-ala on 2000–4000 km2. Kaikkien alueiden bruttopinta-ala on yhteensä noin 60 000 km2. Puustotulkinnan tulee perustua laserkeilaukseen, ilmakuviin ja maastomittauksiin. Hankintayksikkö toimittaa toimittajalle puustotulkinnan lähtöaineistot.

title: COPEX-DP CRISTAL
description: The Copernicus Polar Ice and Snow Topography Altimeter (CRISTAL) mission is being developed by the European Space Agency (ESA) as one of the Copernicus Expansion (COPEX) missions with the objective to measure and monitor sea-ice thickness, overlying snow depth and ice-sheet elevations.CRISTAL will feature a payload that comprises an Interferometric Radar altimeter for Ice and Snow (IRIS) and a Microwave Radiometer (MWR). IRIS will be used to measure the thickness of sea ice and the snow that covers it, as well as the height of the world's ice sheets and glaciers. The dual-frequency operation will enable more accurate measurements than earlier ice-monitoring altimeters. These datasets will support maritime operations in polar oceans and contribute to a better understanding of climate processes through monitoring the cryosphere to fully assess, predict and adapt to climate variability and change.In this context, the European Space Agency (ESA) announces the intended ITT for the development of the CRISTAL operational Level-0 and Level-1 data processors (CRISTAL-DP), encompassing the IRIS and MWR instruments, to be integrated and operated as part of the Copernicus Missions, Data and Operations Management Framework (EOF-CSC). The activity is intended to cover the processors development activities aswell as an optional maintenance and evolution phase possibly up to the end of the CRISTAL-A satellite commissioning phase.These CRISTAL data processors will adhere to the principles of the ESA Copernicus Earth Observation Processor Framework (EOPF) and to the principles of open source, flexibility, native compatibility with cloud-based environments, scalability and adaptability to future technological advancements (e.g., GPU, HPC, etc.).Intended Schedule: ITT Issue: Q4 2024 Planed Kick-Off Date: Summer 2025ThisITT is part of a comprehensive procurement strategy involving six open competitive tenders for the COPEX-DP development, including:-A Generic CADU Processor development (ITT)- A separated ITT for the specialised Level-0 and Level-1 operational processors development for each of the following missions: CRISTAL (scope of this ITT), LSTM, ROSE-L, CIMR, CHIME. These ITTs are planned to be issued gradually between 2024 (CRISTAL) and 2026. Future intended ITTs will be published accordingly in due time.

title: DUAL-ACTIVE 5G NON-TERRESTRIAL NETWORK MODEM WITH SMART RESOURCE MANAGEMENT (ARTES 4.0 SPL 5G/6G 7A.089) - EXPRO+
description: Objective: The objective of the activity is to develop and test a 5G NTN dual active modem prototype with active resource management for improving link reliability and performance, whileoptimizing the space segment resources utilization.TargetedImprovements:-doubling the peak data rate compared to state of art modems.- reduction by half link outage time.Description: The need for a dual-active modem in 5G Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) arises from the growing demand for reliable, high-performance communication links particularly inscenarios where terrestrial networks are unavailable or unreliable. A dual-active NTN modem can maintain two simultaneous satellite links, significantly reducing the risk ofoutages caused by shadowing, fading or interference. At the same time, it provides an additional communication channel that enables load balancing across space segmentnodes, helping to distribute traffic efficiently and improve peak user data rates. Active resource management is essential in this context. Strategies must be designed todynamically allocate resources based on real-time link conditions and performance metrics. These strategies should ensure that the satellite system can optimize keyperformance indicators, such as peak data rate and service availability, while minimizing the resources allocated to each link and network node (e.g. payloads). Developingcontrol plane methodologies is also a critical aspect of this solution. The control plane manages the signalling and control information required for the operation of thecommunication links. It enables the system to gather real-time measurements of links conditions, which are essential for making informed decisions about resource allocationand link management. These methodologies also provide mechanisms for communicating decisions to the network including satellites and user terminals ensuring that thesystem can adapt to changing conditions and maintain optimal performance.This activity will develop a prototype dual-active 5G modem, potentially based on open radio stacks, and implement a testbed to evaluate the prototype under realisticconditions. This testbed will include a channel emulator with multiple RF interfaces to emulate themultiple links. Channel performance as well as satellite system resourcesallocation will be tested for various operational scenarios, and both resource management methodologies and control plane techniques will be assessed.Procurement Policy: C(1) = Activity restricted to non-prime contractors (incl. title: IMPLEMENTATION OF AN ESERO (EUROPEAN SPACE EDUCATION RESOURCE OFFICE) IN LITHUANIA
description: The European Space Education Resource Office (ESERO) is ESA's main project in the field of formal and non-formal early childhood, primary and secondary education. Under the coordination and steering of ESA and the national space agencies and offices, and with the support of national institutions and organizations active in the field of formal and non-formal education, the project aims at enabling capacity building in the school level teacher and educator communities and at designing and promoting the use of didactic resources and activities that make use of space as a context for the teaching and learning of STEM-related disciplines.National ESERO offices are established to implement activities across their hosting country. They are staffed by national education experts able to work in strong synergy and partnership with the national education authorities, stakeholders and networks, as well as the national space sector - an approach that has already proven to be effective and successful across 22 ESA Member States. In July 2026 a new ESERO will be established in an ESA Associate Member State - Latvia. Other countries have also now expressed interest in hosting an ESERO.

title: DEVELOPMENT OF A STANDARDISED PROCESS FOR PHOTONIC INTEGRATED CIRCUITS (PICS) AND ELECTRONICS INTEGRATION TECHNOLOGY (ARTES 4.0 SL SPL 5F.042) EXPRO+ - RE-ISSUE
description: To improve the level of integration between photonics and electronics circuits, which will enable performance and efficiency gains, size reduction and scalability to a high-density photonic integrated circuit (PIC)-based system with 100+ actuators.Targeted Improvements:Improvement in the system scalability (from 10s to 100s actuators per chip) to enable high-density PICs to beintegrated with driving and control mixed-signal electronics circuits. Improvement in the bandwidth of the connection between PIC and electronic circuit. BW 30 GHz is targeted.Description:Photonics Integrated Circuits (PICs) have been identified as enabling technology for future optical and photonics equipment for satellites due to their advantage of reduced SWaP and cost of equipment. Thebroad range of PIC technologies (InP, GaAs, SOI, TFLN, SiN and hybrids) is an advantage, but this variety creates a stumbling blockin implementation for space. In addition, PICs-based equipment requires a dedicated driving electronics, which will often need to operate at higher frequencies (30 GHz) and high voltage or current. This creates a particular challenge for high density PICs which may incorporate a large number of components with 100s of actuators. If we could work towards a unified photonics-electronics integration process and a suitable package assembly for all very high-density PICs, it would facilitate faster implementation of this technology. The considered photonics-electronics connectivity solutions include, but are not limited to, wire-bonds, ribbon-bonds, flip-chip, and heterodyne integration techniques. A coordinated activity is required to support primes (which have interest in all PIC platforms) as well as numerous SMEs packaging companies and European PIC foundries.Procurement Policy: C(1) = Activity restricted tonon-prime contractors (incl. title: Schulungsleistungen Allgemeiner Kursbereich
description: Innerhalb des Deutschen Forschungszentrums für Luft- und Raumfahrt e. V. eruiert die interne Personal- und Organisations-entwicklung (POE) den generellen wie strategischen Weiterbildungsbedarf der Belegschaft des DLR über verschiedene Bedarfserhebungen. Die POE identifiziert relevante Schulungsthemen und entscheidet darüber, welche Themen und Inhalte in welchen Formaten über das DLR-interne Schulungsprogramm der Belegschaft angeboten werden. Die administrative Abwicklung des Schulungsprogramms erfolgt über ein automatisiertes Learning-Management-System. Gegenstand der Leistung ist die Vergabe von Schulungsleistungen im Allgemeinen Kursbereich im Rahmen eines Open-House-Modells mit dem Ziel einer Poolbildung. Werden die Voraussetzungen bezüglich Eignung und Qualifikation (siehe Vergabeunterlagen) erfüllt, erfolgt die Aufnahme in den POE-Pool "Schulungsleistungen Allgemeiner Kursbereich. Aus diesem POE-Pool wählt die Personalentwicklung während der gesamten Laufzeit (bis zu vier Jahre) jeweils fallweise für spezifische Thematiken geeignete Kursleitungen zur Durchführung von Schulungen in Form von Einzelbeauftragungen. Die Anzahl der zu beauftragenden Dienstleistungen ist nicht verbindlich und unterliegt jährlichen Schwankungen. Mit Aufnahme in den Pool erhält jeder Anbieter eine entsprechende losbezogene Rahmenvereinbarung. Mit der Aufnahme begründet sich kein Anspruch auf eine bestimmte Mindestauftragsgröße oder auf ein Mindestauftragsvolumen für den Anbieter. Die Schulungsleistungen sind je nach Qualifikationsanspruch themenbezogen in sechs Lose aufgeteilt. Anbieter können sich für ein, mehrere oder alle Lose bewerben. Die Entscheidung über die Zulassung auf mehrere Lose trifft die Personalentwicklung anhand der Qualifikationsnachweise des Anbieters. Die Vertragslaufzeit im Open House beginnt mit dem Tag der Aufnahme in den POE-Pool Allgemeiner Kursbereich (frühestens im März 2023). Vertragsende für alle Verträge ist der 31.05.2026.
